official_isv_evidence.claim_boundary: Directly supports the logical adjective and national comparison columns; the formal source supplies the system sense.
Supports the international system family and national columns but directly prefers feminine sistema; it is adverse evidence for the edition's masculine sistem form.
Accepted project prose directly uses masculine singular/plural sistem for formal derivation systems; this is an editorial precedent, not external certification.
Supports deterministic Cyrillic projection only, not the Latin lexical selection or specialist sense.

rationale: The source explicitly speaks of other logical systems rather than logic only as a discipline. The adjective is directly frozen and pan-Slavically convergent. Masculine sistem follows the established edition precedent and BCS usage; the dictionary's feminine sistema is retained as adverse evidence rather than hidden.

rejected_alternatives.reason: The frozen dictionary directly prefers sistema and several national traditions use a feminine noun, but the accepted edition already fixes masculine sistem in formal-logic compounds; changing gender here would split one project head.
